pages.text: The Soul Bow draws slowly, and fires weak arrows that $(thing)track nearby targets$() and ignore invincibility frames. It does not consume arrows, cannot be enchanted and has infinite durability.

pages.title: Soul Scaling
pages.text: As you accumulate soul energy, both $(thing)draw speed$() and $(thing)arrow damage$() increase proportionally. At high soul energy, the bow transforms from sluggish to devastating.$(br2)Holding the bow also passively increases your movement speed based on current soul energy.

pages.title: Default Skill: Sonic Boom
pages.text: Hold $(thing)Shift$() while releasing an arrow to unleash a Warden-style $(thing)sonic boom$() instead. This consumes a large amount of soul energy and deals massive armor-piercing area damage.$(br2)The sonic boom will not harm villagers, players, or passive mobs.
